# Camp Alta Kiruna

> Arctic wilderness camp in Kiruna, Swedish Lapland (67.86°N), offering cabin accommodation and adventure tours year-round.

## About

Camp Alta Kiruna is a wilderness camp located on the shores of Lake Altajärvi, 7 km from Kiruna city center in Swedish Lapland, 200 km north of the Arctic Circle. We offer affordable cabin accommodation ranging from small cozy cabins for 2 guests to large houses for up to 14 guests, plus caravan/motorhome spots.

- Address: Jullebovägen 2, 981 92 Kiruna, Sweden
- Contact: info@campalta.se | +46 706 529 374
- Website: https://campalta.net
- Coordinates: 67.8558°N, 20.2253°E

## Accommodation

We have 13 forest cabins and 4 premium lakeside aurora cabins:

### Small Cabins (12m2, sleep 2)
- Cabin D1-D3, 2A-B, 2C, 3, 4A-B, 4C, 4D, 5
- Shared bathrooms, fridge, freezer, microwave, WiFi, Cable TV, heating

### Medium Cabins (25-40m2, sleep 4-6)
- Cabin 6A-C (40m2): 2 bedrooms, private bathroom, kitchen, lake views
- Cabin 6B (25m2): 1 bedroom, private bathroom, kitchen

### Large Houses
- Cabin 13A (90m2): Sleeps 8, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, full kitchen
- Cabin 13B (130m2): Sleeps 8, 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, full kitchen
- Cabin 14 (162m2): Sleeps 14, 5 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, full kitchen

### Lakeside Aurora Cabins (Premium)
- Cabin 4E, 4F, 6D, 8B: Premium lakefront cabins with aurora views

### Included Amenities
All cabins include electricity, heating, fridge, freezer, microwave, WiFi, and Cable TV. Free amenities: wood-fired saunas (including floating lake sauna), fire hut with grill, and parking.

## Tours

### Snowmobile Tour (32km through Lapland)
- Duration: 3 hours
- Two sharing a snowmobile: 1,500 SEK/adult, 850 SEK/child (4-12)
- One person per snowmobile: 1,900 SEK/adult
- Times: 09:00-12:00 or 13:30-16:30 daily
- Starting point: Camp Alta
- Optional lunch add-on and Icehotel transfer available

### Dogsled Tour with Coffee (2-3 hours)
- Ride on a large sled driven by a professional musher with Alaskan & Siberian Huskies
- Price: 1,465 SEK/adult, 800 SEK/child (under 12)
- Includes transfers from Kiruna, warm winter clothes, coffee/tea with Swedish fika
- Location: Jukkasjärvi

### Dogsled Lunch Tour (4-5 hours)
- Choose to share or drive your own sled
- Price: 1,995 SEK/adult, 990 SEK/child (under 12)
- Includes hot lunch, transfers, and warm winter clothes
- Minimum age: 9 years old
- Start time: 09:00

### Northern Lights Dogsled Tour (2-3 hours)
- Evening sled ride driven by a professional musher with chance to see the Northern Lights
- Price: 1,580 SEK/adult, 800 SEK/child (under 12)
- From March 11th to April 14th: 1,495 SEK/adult, 748 SEK/child (lower aurora visibility)
- Includes transfers, warm winter clothes, coffee/tea with Swedish fika
- Start time: 17:00
- Minimum age: 6 years old

### Evening Dogsled Tour (March-April)
- Late-season evening sled tour, post-aurora season
- Price: 1,495 SEK/adult, 748 SEK/child (under 12)
- Same inclusions as Northern Lights dogsled tour

### Northern Lights Tour to Abisko
- Duration: 6+ hours (18:00-01:00)
- Price: 1,600 SEK/adult, 800 SEK/child (6-12)
- Travel to Abisko National Park, one of the best places on Earth for aurora viewing
- Includes transportation, professional winter gear, snacks, warm drinks, and photos

### Aurora Adventure Safari (2 hours)
- Duration: 2 hours (21:00-23:00)
- Price: 800 SEK/adult, 500 SEK/child (4-12)
- Comfortable sled pulled by guide's snowmobile through Arctic wilderness
- Distance: 18km
- Starting point: Camp Alta

All tours include transfers from Kiruna and warm winter clothing.

## Seasons

- **Winter** (November-April): Northern Lights, dogsledding, snowmobile tours, ice fishing, snow activities
- **Summer** (May-September): Midnight Sun, hiking, fishing, kayaking, tranquil nature experiences
